title: Concise Binary Object Representation (CBOR)
summary: Defines the Concise Binary Object Representation (CBOR), a binary data format designed for very small code size, fairly small messages and extensibility without version negotiation. It differs from earlier binary formats such as ASN.1 and MessagePack. It has been replaced by RFC 8949.

eli5.summary: A way to write down information in a very compact secret-shorthand that small gadgets can read quickly.
